spec: esm-spec §4.8.6 (bare numeric literals read as dimensionless: the warning stage); CONFORMANCE_SPEC §7.1 (`units_dimensionless_literal_mismatch`)
description: Stage 1 of the transition that makes a bare numeric literal DIMENSIONLESS at scale 1 (the literal zero excepted). At this stage every binding evaluates each check site under BOTH the current neutral-literal rule and the new rule, and reports a `units_dimensionless_literal_mismatch` WARNING where only the new rule finds a mismatch. Validity is decided by the current rule alone, so every file here is valid.

cases.assert: warns at /models/Literals/equations/0..6 (additive offset T - 273.15; 1 + x; conversion factor P_pa / 101325.0; exp(-1370 / T); literal coefficient 1.4 * phi carrying a unit; dx [m] = 1 / 64; H_ice > 0.01) and /models/Literals/equations/21 (theta_deg [deg] / 57.29577951308232 against a pure number: the angle axis cancels but the deg scale is kept, esm-spec §4.8.3), and at /reaction_systems/Chem/reactions/0 (exp(-1370 / T) in a rate)

NO warning at /models/Literals/equations/7..14 (max(x, 0); ifelse(c > 0, x, 0); D(q) = -(k * q); ic(q) = 0.0; ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0); T - const(273.15, units K); 2 * pi * f * tau; 0.5 * x + x) nor at /models/Literals/equations/20 (pi/2 - 2*atan(z): an angle meeting a pure number counts as dimensionless, esm-spec §4.8.3) nor at /reaction_systems/Chem/reactions/1
validate() is_valid == true: the warning never changes validity at this stage

cases.input: (the 13 tests/valid files the golden lists with a nonempty warning set: 44 warnings)
cases.assert: each stays VALID and carries exactly the listed warnings; these are the files that pin today's neutral-literal rule, which the stage-2 codemod (scripts/codemod-dimensionless-literals.py) deliberately leaves alone, and the sites no literal rewrite repairs
